hypotheses.statement: Tightening the global J bound to the #269 level activates mu and restores the SID capacity and local ranking.
The inherited lambda local curvature term improves the local A.1 without degrading the SID.
The local MAE gain is a scale shrink that the non-degeneracy check excludes.
The L2>=10918 and rank>=8 conjunction is unreachable in the tested kappa_t lambda family (X_tested only; not an X_allowed proof).
Balancing the local weight at 10% of the global gradient scales the local term without destroying the assignment.
The assignment capacity collapses above a local-weight threshold.
The local and global codebook-side gradients are the channel that compresses L2/rank and degrades the SID ordering; scaling that channel by beta=0.01 restores rank/L2 and the ordering.

The pointwise curvature loss compresses the within-centre curvature differences (it is blind to a common offset); adding a same-centre difference protection L_delta restores the differences (C6/C7), and with it the Spearman/sign/variance/slope (C2-C5), without costing SID capacity (C12/C13) or reconstruction (C15).
